skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply economic theories and models to identify issues accurately in real-world economic organizations.
Develop and enhance analytical, argumentative, and evaluative skills for economic policies and decisions.
Master the skills of summarizing literature and analyzing related data in research.
Develop independent research skills, teamwork abilities, and presentation skills.
Enhance self-study and research capabilities on specialized economic topics.
Improve critical thinking and professional judgment skills.
Demonstrate organizational discipline, legal compliance, cooperative spirit, and responsibility in group activities.
